description: An ID that two phones compute alike without talking to each other (ADR 0038), so two technicians who both start the report of a work order offline, or both answer the same checklist item, write to the same record instead of making two. UUIDv8 (RFC 9562): the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(the 16 bytes of namespace ‖ UTF-8 of name), with the version nibble set to 8 and the variant bits to 10. Written in lower case.

cases.name: the report of a work order (version 1)
the answer to a checklist item
upper-case input is the same UUID
